chunks: So that when they reach it their ears and eyes and skins will testify to what they did.

key_terms.جَاءُوهَا: They reach it (referring to Hell or the place of reckoning)

ai.seo_question: What do the ears, eyes, and skin testify against on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia tafsir as a sign of the 'Qiyamah al-Jismiyah' (Resurrection of the Body), illustrates how the physical organs themselves will testify against their owners, validating the unity of body and soul in divine judgment. It underscores the precision of Allah's knowledge, where even the parts used to commit sins become active witnesses, reinforcing the concept of 'Adl' (Divine Justice) where no deed escapes reckoning.
